Shader dir:   C:\Users\jonas\Desktop\GpuSort-portable-495478d\GpuSort-portable-495478d\shaders
Algo list:    algorithms_scale.txt
CSV files:    scale_smoke.csv (per GPU x algorithm x workload), scale_smoke_samples.csv (per iteration), scale_smoke_wave_probe.csv (per wave configuration); columns: CSV_FORMAT.md
Iterations:   per sorts-per-iteration count (every GPU x workload x algorithm runs once per count,
              in this order), measured + 0 warmup: 20 sorts: 8, 128 sorts: 8, 256 sorts: 8, 512 sorts: 8
Cache flush:  256 MB read+write compute pass before every timed sort, then a DRAIN right before the
              start timestamp (a dispatch on a private 4 KB buffer + UAV barrier), so the tail of the
              flush (barrier wait / cache maintenance a driver defers to the next dispatch) is not
              inside the timed window.
Flush mode:   'full_d50' for algorithms without their own (the measurement of record).
              *** NOTE: the default is full_d50 (flush, then a ~50 us ALU spin drain) since the final
              *** set; packages up to 627724b used 'full' (flush + the pass5 one-group drain), which
              *** on the RX 7900 XTX still timed ~12 us of post-flush penalty in most small-workload
              *** iterations (mostly_empty median full 14.7 vs full_d50 1.8 us), and pass0-pass4 used
              *** full_legacy (no drain). Results measured with another default are NOT directly
              *** comparable; the flush_mode column / the Algorithms list below says which one ran.
              full = code + data cold (flush, one-group drain, pass5); full_legacy = pre-pass5 full
              (no drain); full_ro = read-only flush, no drain (diagnostic); code = only code cold
              (flush before the upload, drain); data = only data cold (untimed warm-up run of the
              same dispatches, drain); none = no flush (drain)
              Drain suffixes (pass6): <mode>_d<N> = SPIN drain of about N us instead (an ALU-only
              dispatch, 4 groups x 64 threads, one 16-byte store per thread to the private 4 KB
              buffer, loop count from the per-GPU calibration below, + UAV barrier); _d0 = no drain
              (full_d0 = full_legacy); _dg = the pass5 one-group drain
Timing:       GPU timestamps around the sort ExecuteIndirect dispatches only, per iteration (all N sorts
              of the batch, N = the sorts per iteration of the table)
